tail:
Batch 4 authoring is complete: **9 A-page items and 4 B-page examples**, with frontmatter-only pages, manifests, contracts, source evidence, dependency inputs, and batch notes.

The plan and spec agree on scope. Full-text sources included [Mohri et al.](https://cs.nyu.edu/~mohri/mlbook/), [Bartlett and Mendelson](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v3/bartlett02a.html), and [Shalev-Shwartz and Ben-David](https://www.inf.u-szeged.hu/~turan/ML-Konyv.pdf). The batch evidence records locators, dispositions, retrieval history, and the Sauer–Shelah erratum.

All 13 items have current, non-owner **Step-1 ready** records. Checks passed for proof layout (13 items, 38 steps), precheck, rendering, strict proof contracts, citation fidelity (87 citations), source coverage (5/5 sources), content policy, focused dependency checks, and statement continuity. The assigned manifest’s dependency IDs and levels match.

**Run-level reconciliation remains:** Autopilot still lists batch 4 as missing native dispatch coverage and the run is held at `1-scaffold` (57/101) by an owner repair/recertification blocker. The dispatch says batch 4 requires batch 3; the current dependency artifact says batches 2 and 3, both at level 2. I recorded both hashes and requirements without changing engine state. The full-run dependency check reports 58 errors from empty inventories on unassigned pages; none concern batch 4. A run-wide dependency-ledger refresh also encounters an unrelated malformed batch-81 sidecar.

Key evidence: [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-4.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-4.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-4.proof-contracts.json), and [dependency inputs](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-4.dependency-inputs.json). Independent review and later workflow gates remain pending.
